remediations: Removed the required marketing baseUrl and made @/* map explicitly to ./app/*.
Removed the activity Vinext fixture baseUrl so every tracked config satisfies the adopted no-baseUrl policy.
Kept packages/db tsconfig.build module at ES2022 after a real TypeScript 7 showConfig probe confirmed it is compatible with bundler resolution.
Removed scanner-only Jest, Vitest, and Playwright type additions; imported runner modules provide their own declarations and do not prove ambient-global use.
Retained Node types only in package configs with compiler-proven Node diagnostics and removed unsupported app-level Node entries after the all-config parity gate.
Changed the live repository assertion from a baseline-specific expected baseUrl violation to an empty violation set; deliberately-invalid fixture cases remain unchanged.

Removed the repository regex ambient-type verdict because it could not distinguish imports, string content, and tsconfig include/exclude semantics. Actual compiler parity is the authoritative ambient-type gate.
review_input: Independent Phase 3b audit identified the false-positive regex behavior and verified that ES2022 plus bundler is accepted by TypeScript 7.0.2. It also supplied focused Node-type probes for package configs.
acceptance: The provenance-bound Phase 3c run completed all 39 TypeScript 6/7 compiler pairs with stable inputs, zero failures, and exact one-time application of every reviewed ledger entry.
